name: jig
description: Spec-driven, review-enforced, hook-gated AI-native development workflow for Codex

interface.longDescription: jig packages spec workflow, review prompts, deterministic hooks, and scaffold helpers for Codex. Install as a plugin for centralized skills and hooks, then review and trust bundled hooks via /hooks before they run; or run scaffold-init with --host codex to copy editable project-local Codex files.
defaultPrompt: Set up this project for AI-native development
Start the next jig spec slice
Run jig review passes for this slice
